set.body:
Purpose:
Serve as the independent closeout gate for the review-follow-up epic and connect its evidence to the open out-of-core workflow acceptance scenario.

Acceptance scenario:
- Use a realistic fMRIPrep-style multi-run fixture with normalized BOLD data, events, optional confounds, run-specific and common masks, one compressed input, and byte-authored datatype variants.
- Compile the fixture header-first into deterministic units without reading voxel payloads eagerly.
- Read dense, sparse, censored, and arbitrarily ordered blocks and compare them with an analytic or simple dense reference using explicit tolerances.
- Assert the read-plan window count, positional-read count, and maximum buffer size; do not infer scalability only from elapsed time.
- Verify compressed staging reuse, cleanup after injected failure, and no partial finalized artifact.
- Verify confounds=None, requested confounds, Explicit, RequireCommonDerivative, and IntersectRunMasks behavior plus all retained catalog/preflight error codes.
- Record the representative benchmark command and baseline output.
- Run imageJVM/test, imageJS/test, datasetJVM/test, datasetJS/test, fmriWorkflowJVM/test, fmriWorkflowJS/test, compileAll, and testAll.
- Re-run shared-source platform-import and reverse-dependency scans plus scoped whitespace/diff checks.
- Update dataset/fmri-workflow README and module-relations wording so the performance and policy contracts are reader-visible.

Exit criterion:
No child implementation item self-certifies this gate. Close only after the commands, counts, benchmark receipt, and any caveats are recorded in a tracker note.
set.title: Review closeout: prove cross-platform and study-scale ingest acceptance
